lore_anchors.definition: A powerful puppet or golem crafted in the form of the mythical beast Qiongqi, often possessing immense combat power.
A combined battle formation that significantly amplifies the power of multiple golems or cultivators working in unison.
A cultivation technique of the highest quality, typically belonging to and created for use by Celestial Immortals.

A rare type of magical technique that manipulates a cultivator's spiritual perception for direct mental attacks, defenses, or manifestation; separate from Ki techniques or body-refining divine abilities.
A soul-linked artifact kept in a clan's ancestral hall that shatters upon the death of its owner, providing instantaneous confirmation of death.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Ji Ning leave the golems behind instead of keeping them?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He is confident in his own strength, stating he can kill Primal Daoists as easily as if he had them. More importantly, he knows his clan needs the protection more than he does.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why can't the Shaoyan Clan simply slaughter the mortals of the Yan Mountains?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Massacring mortals incurs massive karmic sin, which taints the fortune of the entire clan. Ancient, orthodox clans value their luck too much to risk it for petty revenge.
